notes: Manufacturer page (avocor.com/products/e50-series/) lists specs for the whole E50 Series (AVE-5550/6550/7550/8650); AVE-7550 is the 75" model. HDMI input/output versions confirmed as HDMI 2.0 by manufacturer and corroborated by B&H/Almo/Staples listings. DisplayPort confirmed as 1.2. USB-A/USB-B ports stated as "USB 3.0" (mapped to usb-5g/SuperSpeed) but exact USB 3.x generation (3.0/3.1/3.2) not specified — treated as usb-5g baseline. RJ45 LAN in/out ports confirmed present but Ethernet speed (1G vs other) not stated by any source found; assumed eth-1g as typical for this display class — flagged as inferred. Power connector type (IEC C13/14 vs other) not explicitly published; inferred from the well-documented practice of shipping detachable, region-specific AC cords (US/UK/EU/AUS) with commercial displays of this class — a NEMA captive-cord design would not require multiple regional cord SKUs. OPS PC slot exists but is a modular compute slot rather than a physical A/V port, so it was not modeled as a port. Could not access Avocor's own PDF datasheet (Zendesk-hosted, returned 403 to automated fetch) or the B&H/Almo spec tables directly (403), so this relies on the manufacturer's live product page plus corroborating retailer search snippets (B&H, Almo Pro AV, Staples, Smartboards) that reported matching port counts/types.
